real-estate presale, sales, delivery and land-bank lifecycles rather than rentable storage-unit assignment, tenant access and ready-to-rent turnover
payment processing and consumer lending delinquency or collections rather than storage rent, facility lockout, statutory lien and unit auction closure
physical-goods inventory custody rather than a tenant's leased unit occupancy and access rights without reading stored property contents
equipment rental dispatch and return rather than stationary storage-unit occupancy, access activation, lien enforcement and vacate inspection
physical-records-management custody rather than general-customer self-storage tenancy, unit access and lien-auction lifecycle

complete 2019-2023 applicable denominators including available, quoted, reserved, cancelled, leased, assigned, moved-in, access-active, occupied, locked, maintenance, damaged, claimed, invoiced, paid, payment-failed, delinquent, noticed, cured, liened, auctioned, unsold, refunded, vacated, inspected, turned and ready-to-rent states

scientific_interpretation: A linked issuer-as-self-storage operator inquiry, reservation, lease, unit occupancy and access, rent delinquency, statutory lien, auction, vacate and ready-to-rent lifecycle is economically distinct from equipment rental, accounting lease, real estate development, goods inventory, consumer lending, payment processing and physical-records management.
